summary: Master alternative investment strategies for pension funds. Learn due diligence, risk management, and ESG integration to optimize long-term portfolio returns.
lede: Alternative investment strategies for pension funds include private equity, real estate, infrastructure, hedge funds and private credit. This course is for pension fund investment professionals responsible for allocating to and overseeing these assets. It covers practical due diligence and manager selection, liquidity forecasting for capital calls and pension payouts, and valuation and performance assessment for private-market investments.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals responsible for the strategic direction, execution, and oversight of pension fund assets in a complex global market.
modules: Strategic Asset Allocation and Alternatives Foundations
Private Equity and Venture Capital Mechanics
Real Assets: Real Estate and Infrastructure
Hedge Funds and Private Credit Strategies
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in investment management, pension fund administration, or financial analysis. A working knowledge of basic financial mathematics (NPV, IRR) and familiarity with traditional asset classes (equities and bonds) is required. No prior experience in private markets is necessary, but participants must be comfortable using Excel for financial modeling exercises.
